name: PACER Surge Tool
description: Free public-access hospital surge capacity planning tool using Monte Carlo simulation to model patient surge scenarios for mass casualty incidents and pandemic situations. Helps hospitals and health systems plan resource allocation (beds, ventilators, staff) under highly uncertain demand conditions.
domain: hospital surge planning, mass casualty response, public health emergency
reputation: recognized free tool in US hospital emergency preparedness community
notes: Free public access tool. Monte Carlo approach generates probability distributions of surge demand rather than point estimates, supporting probabilistic planning. Used for pandemic and MCI planning.

institutions: PACER (Public Administration Center for Emergency Response)
